assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: native raster animation sprite atlas for the Horizons English study companion app. Produce EXACTLY FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS × FOUR EQUAL ROWS, sixteen separate square cells on a square canvas. Every row is one DISTINCT FULL-BODY POSTURE; its four columns are four successive, coherent small-action animation frames. The four ROWS must have genuinely different whole-body silhouettes, leg positions and weight distribution—not a standing character with four arm poses. Keep the camera, body proportions, character scale and prop positions fixed within each row. Body anatomy and identity consistent across the entire sheet, including the same head size; do not enlarge seated/crouched poses to fill all available height. Every complete head, hand, foot and prop must be inside its cell with at least10% transparent safety padding all around. No overlap across cell boundaries. Genuine ALPHA TRANSPARENT background, no colored background, no grid lines, no labels, no letters, no text. Clean, friendly, tasteful flat vector-like RASTER illustrations matching the references exactly, with gentle restrained shading and crisp edges. This is an adult-friendly, all-ages education app. Animate meaningful facial, wrist, elbow and task gestures; do not animate floating, repeated whole-body bobbing or scale wobble. The four frames of each row must form a clear loop, with frame4 returning towards frame1. Four coherent phases, no extra limbs or detached joints. References: Image1 is the full-cast identity/style reference; Image2 is the same character's isolated outfit/head/prop identity reference. Integrate normal open eyes and mouth on the actual face; the second reference contains blank faces only because it was an old rig kit, so DO NOT reproduce a blank face. CHARACTER: MINA, the first/left woman in Image1. Keep her warm tan skin, dark brown shoulder-length wavy bob, friendly expressive brown eyes, magenta open cardigan/jacket, cream T-shirt, navy cropped trousers, orange sneakers and small orange backpack. ROW1: Mina takes an adventurous FORWARD STEPPING stance, one knee bent forward and rear heel raised, torso leaning slightly forward. With one arm she points out a route, then opens the pointing hand in invitation and looks back towards viewer, then resets. Preserve the grounded step silhouette through the four action phases; do not walk her out of the cell. ROW2: Mina is genuinely KNEELING/CROUCHING with one knee on the ground, the opposite knee raised, body lowered. An open folded paper map rests across the raised thigh. She traces a route with her finger, glances up with a pleased smile, blinks, and traces again. This must visibly be a low kneeling body, not a shortened standing person. ROW3: Mina SITS on a simple little wooden bench, hips and both knees visibly bent, feet fully visible below, open navy/cream book in her hands. Her backpack can sit beside her on the bench. She reads, turns a page with one hand, looks up and smiles, then returns to reading. Bench stays exactly fixed and complete in all four cells. ROW4: Mina is in a joyous ONE-LEG SKIPPING CELEBRATION stance: one planted foot, opposite leg bent backwards at the knee, torso tilted with happy energy, both forearms lifted. She opens her hands in delight, brings them closer in a small excited gesture, smiles with a blink, and resets. Keep the full bent-back leg and foot visible. No floating jump: a planted foot anchors every frame. Each of the four row silhouettes must read immediately as stepping, kneeling, bench-sitting, and one-leg skipping.
assets.rowCutPolicy: Metadata only; cuts are in the actual native transparent gaps. This avoids clipping the complete stance when the generated row spacing differs from exact quarters.
